subject.title: feat(browser): import Chrome-family system-profile cookies into managed profiles

question: Should OpenClaw agents be allowed to trigger a default-enabled transfer of host browser session cookies into a durable managed profile?
rationale: This changes the trust model from operating an authorized live browser to copying reusable authentication credentials into an agent-controlled store; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended product-security boundary.

options.title: Require explicit authorization
options.body: Default the capability off or require a clear per-import user confirmation, while documenting that the resulting managed profile holds reusable session credentials.

options.title: Allow agent-directed import
options.body: Treat macOS Keychain consent as sufficient authorization and explicitly accept default-on durable credential transfer for host-controlled agents.

options.title: Retain live-browser access only
options.body: Do not add durable cookie copying and continue using the existing-session browser path for authenticated activity.

recommendation.title: Require explicit authorization
recommendation.body: Default the capability off or require a clear per-import user confirmation, while documenting that the resulting managed profile holds reusable session credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent browser security and product-history signal and authored the proposed feature direction.
